name: RAND
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A raw percussion synth: one voice, eight steps, a clock that turns into a tone
description: A percussion synth after the Behringer EDGE and Moog DFAM: two oscillators with FM and sync, noise, a 24 dB ladder filter, three envelopes, drive, ping-pong delay, reverb and master filter. An 8-step sequencer with a pitch and a velocity knob per step whose clock runs up to x128, where the rhythm turns into a tone. The keys are a patchbay: hold a black key (an output: VCOs, noise, envelopes, LFO, random, trigger) and tap a white key (an input: pitch, FM, cutoff, VCA, tempo, delay, reverb, crush). Eight presets, MIDI clock in.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
